svg.title: DrugAssist database schema
svg.desc: Annotated core schema of the three separate local stores. Solid arrows show matching declared SQL foreign keys. Dashed arrows show application or file relationships. Chroma segments.collection declares an unmatched singular table reference, explicitly noted as A.
svg.text: Three separate local stores. Core tables and selected columns, verified 20 October 2026.
Matching declared FK: parent to child
Application / storage link, not a matching SQL FK
PK = primary key NN = NOT NULL
data/chroma/chroma.sqlite3 | Active: 8,601 chunks, 1,536 dimensions, cosine HNSW
Same typed value columns as above
Vectors and graph/index bookkeeping; not SQL tables
Vector data can also be present in this log
embedding_id = app chunk_id; embeddings has no vector column.
FK: sessions.user_id -> users.id; ON DELETE CASCADE. Times are Unix seconds.
Key: digest of embedding fingerprint + exact text.
Value: float32 vector, checked by application code.
A Observed DDL references collection(id), but the existing table is collections. Dashed link records the intended relationship.
B Segment membership and index-file paths are application links, not declared matching SQL foreign keys.
UQ = unique constraint; multiple PK columns form one composite key. Additional Chroma maintenance tables are omitted.
See database-schema.md for field mapping, source-file lineage, full annotations and implementation references.
